findings.message: Item A confirmed with physical-fidelity evidence: UNRELIABLE_TRANSPORT_MAPPING='RAW_ENET_UNRELIABLE_APPLICATION_SEQUENCED_V1' accurately describes existing behavior. In scripts/network/transports/v2/enet_multi_peer_transport_port.gd (_transfer_mode), delivery_mode 'UNRELIABLE_SEQUENCED' maps to MultiplayerPeer.TRANSFER_MODE_UNRELIABLE_ORDERED, which Godot's ENetMultiplayerPeer emits WITHOUT ENET_PACKET_FLAG_RELIABLE (unreliable on the wire; fragmented unreliable datagrams carry ENET_PACKET_FLAG_UNRELIABLE_FRAGMENT and get_packet_mode() decodes them back as TRANSFER_MODE_UNRELIABLE_ORDERED - same shared mapping used at receiver, so declared==physical identity holds size-independently). Sequencing is application-owned: every frame carries an application 'sequence' field (receive path records int(frame['sequence'])), realtime_channel_policy.sequence_stream() defines app-level stream identity 'UNRELIABLE_SEQUENCED|ENET_CHANNEL_<i>', and REALTIME_COALESCING_POLICY='LATEST_PENDING_TRANSACTIONAL_REPLACEMENT_PER_STREAM_V1' performs latest-wins replacement per application stream. Nuance (non-blocking): ENet itself also sequences within a channel under UNRELIABLE_ORDERED, so 'APPLICATION_SEQUENCED' denotes app-owned sequence bookkeeping/coalescing rather than absence of any wire-level ordering; this does not contradict the pinned value.

Git narrative of item A3 verified via git show: constant introduced as RAW_ENET_UNRELIABLE_APPLICATION_SEQUENCED_V1 by ac8ae0af; 0fdf74fa (2026-08-22, 'fix(eg4): keep global UNRELIABLE_SEQUENCED remap, refresh NX2 pins and record decision') deliberately kept the RAW_ENET pin (test assertion at that revision pins ChannelPolicy.UNRELIABLE_TRANSPORT_MAPPING == 'RAW_ENET_...', decision rationale recorded in EG4 notes and commit body); P6 commit 9e0cc74f (2026-08-23, 'control(p6): P6 implementation (ownership, identity, ledger, admission, closure, route, outpost, persistence, shadow)') silently flipped the constant to ENET_UNRELIABLE_ORDERED_APPLICATION_SEQUENCED_V1 without any mention in its commit message - accidental drift confirmed.

No runtime or test consumer depends on the drifted value: grep over scripts/, tests/, config/network/ finds zero references to ENET_UNRELIABLE_ORDERED_APPLICATION_SEQUENCED_V1; the only literal pins are the restored policy constant, the test assertion, the protocol-manifest mirror (by reference), and control/validation documents (validation/v16.12.0-network-nx2-realtime-traffic-separation-validation.json pins the RAW_ENET value). Restoration is behavior-neutral.

Working tree contains a few untracked *.uid sidecars (scripts/ecology/*, tests/runtime/test_v0_p3_replica_clock_delta_reordering.gd.uid) outside lane scope; they are NOT committed on this branch (66deb469 already dropped committed sidecars) and do not affect the origin/main..HEAD fence. No action required for this WO.
